description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2
